skill1.name: Crimson Cleave
skill1.description: Leap forward and smash downward with the greatsword, fracturing the earth and stunning enemies.

skill2.name: Steel Aegis
skill2.description: Cross sword and dagger into an X-guard, projecting a geometric energy barrier that absorbs projectiles.

ultimate.name: Tectonic Cataclysm
ultimate.description: Plunge greatsword deep into earth, unleashing a 15-meter straight line of erupting steel blades.
